correctness.rationale: For every p>=5 the normalized cubic window on Z_(p²) has ambiguity magnitude exactly 1 at origin, 1/p for p∤u, 1/sqrt(p) for u=ph≠0 and p|v, zero otherwise, by odd prime-power quadratic Gauss sums. Two-dimensional Fourier inversion recovers every between-residue outer product, each nonzero within-block cyclic autocorrelation, and total energy. For >=3 populated blocks pairwise scalar relations force common unit phase. For two blocks reciprocal positive scales plus the single total-energy equation give at most one distinct partner, exactly at both perfect autocorrelation and unequal energies. Independently constructed p=5 exact-index numeric ambiguity (625 entries) and spectrogram partner (625 intensities) gave errors <1e-14, corroborating, not proving all primes.
residual_risks: p>=5 only, full noiseless p^4 measurement entries.
Gauss sums and Fourier inversion prove all primes; independent tests only p=5.
